museum_aaa_3d_vertical_slice.name: Endless Museum — First Embodied Court
museum_aaa_3d_vertical_slice.truth: Architecture hosts artifact contracts; it does not replace them.
museum_aaa_3d_vertical_slice.qfep_connection: Different bodies and operations retain different spatial claims while a shared host provides one walkable world.
museum_aaa_3d_vertical_slice.description: A playable architectural proof containing a wall instrument, a productive machine, and a monumental two-sided environment.
learning_objectives: Read three distinct placement contracts inside one architectural host
Distinguish artifact-owned space from floor-plan-owned routing
Verify that a reusable shell can preserve one-metre modular placement
